published_assertion: A nonconstant separable P1_k-map with image in the smooth locus has an injective canonical tangent differential. The current assertion is its characteristic-zero nonzero cotangent form.
canonical_map_evidence: PhaseThirty.pulledFunctionDifferential is defined on every open by a -> d(f.app a).
PhaseThirty.cotangentMap_adjoint proves the actual pullback-pushforward adjunct is differentialLift of that derivation.
Skeleton.ContactDerivativeIsoProof.cotangentMap_differential proves the same formula on actual pulled local differentials.

expanded_hypotheses.source_scheme: Proj of the homogeneous binary polynomial algebra; its map to Spec(C) is Proj.toSpecZero followed by the given coefficient-spectrum isomorphism.
expanded_hypotheses.target: Actual smooth proper complex variety; smoothness is stronger than smoothness along the image.
expanded_hypotheses.map: RationalCurve supplies an actual map over C and denies factorization through a C-valued point.
expanded_hypotheses.separability: The induced map to the curve image gives an algebraic function-field extension in characteristic zero. The separate generic algebraic characteristic-zero separability lemma has passed native checking. It does not assert that an arbitrary transcendental target extension is algebraic.
expanded_hypotheses.coefficient_identification: The given degree-zero spectrum isomorphism is a base identification of the same polynomial Proj. Existing project base-isomorphism transport retains this map; it is not an arbitrary structure morphism.

limitations: The source paragraph says the tangent sheaf is contained in the pullback tangent sheaf; the intended inclusion is the differential, as indicated by the separability/Frobenius discussion. The audited local formula fixes this canonical interpretation.
The tiny field check does not construct the image normalization or claim a new global proof of the differential theorem. The latter remains the published primitive.
